tools.name: get_build_guide
tools.description: Returns the step-by-step build instructions for one costume idea: the decision summary (time and effort level), the materials list with buy-vs-own tags, numbered build steps, safety notes, and common parent questions with answers. Accepts a costume idea id or a costume name.
